description: Nail salons on Lacquer in a US city + state or ZIP code, optionally narrowed by salon name. Up to 20 per call; "total" says how many match, and "offset" pages through the rest. Salons that take online bookings ("books_online": true) come first; a salon with books_online false has no open times online and is listed with its phone number. Within that, Lacquer partner salons ("partner": true) come first; the rest rotate daily, and the order says nothing about quality.

city.description: City, e.g. "Santa Monica". Used together with state.

offset.description: Number of results to skip; a result's next_offset gives the next page.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code. Used instead of city/state when given.

name: find_salons
title: Find nail salons
